verdict.rationale: Ghostty ships automation surfaces such as an AppleScript dictionary, Apple Shortcuts and bindable actions, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows a product feature for versioning, reviewing or rolling back those automations. Splitting config into files and reloading it at runtime are adjacent config features. Keeping plain-text config in git would be a user-side workaround, not a Ghostty capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
